cohort: Human fetal membranes from normal, term cesareans, chorionic trophoblast cells (CTC), and a BeWo placental trophoblast cell line were used in this study.
finding: The study found that NHERF-1 regulates P-gp and its drug efflux function in human fetal membrane cells, suggesting a role for fetal membranes in controlling drug transportation across the feto-maternal interface.
